body:
## What's Changed
* fix(compose): forward extra models and idle unload knobs to laya-serve by @NAVEENPRASAATH23 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1053
* fix(compose): forward batch tokens and strict Jev knobs to laya-serve by @NAVEENPRASAATH23 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1054
* feat(router): warn when a registered name is one edit from a built-in by @sathariels in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1055
* fix(ts): close the hook timeout template literal in hooks.ts by @sathariels in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1056
* fix(java): router hooks review fixes that #1046's merge did not include by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1057
* fix(java): answer single-option questions instead of failing in TopK by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1059
* feat(java): add Router.predictBatch, so batched decisions can run on a router by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1060
* feat(java): port predict_tournament as Shortlist.predictTournament by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1061
* fix(shortlist): drop option_order when a narrow no longer fits it by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1063
* feat(serve): report Jev's confidence formula as x_jev_confidence (#302) by @kmitul in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1066
* docs: note on int8 dynamic quantization on CPU (#1065) by @sathariels in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1067
* fix(ci): pin tokenizer reference for reproducible parity tables by @debjyotikm in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1068
* test(router): document and verify explicit Java/.NET defaults by @debjyotikm in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1069
* feat(evals): compare student agreement with repeated teacher decisions by @xinpingzh in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1071

## New Contributors
* @kmitul made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1066
* @debjyotikm made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1068

body:
## [6.3.0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/compare/rea-agents-6.2.0...rea-agents-6.3.0) (2026-10-09)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **captures:** Historical captures without current producer accounting or transaction identity, and web diffs missing accessibility or storage dimensions, are rejected. Preserve original captures and recapture with the current producer; update comparison consumers to include every dimension rather than synthesizing missing observations. See the [process capture guide](docs/process-capture.md) and [browser scenario contract](docs/browser-scenario-contract.md). ([3283a45](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3283a45d09457c79e3adadb50a48620926d4bc5b))
* **browser:** JSON shape paths now contain typed property and array-element segments. WebMCP input_schema_shape is replaced by input_schema and input_schema_sha256, retaining declared examples and defaults.
* **process:** Filesystem digest omission entries now require system_code; budget and changed-file omissions use null, and unavailable-file omissions preserve the operating-system error code.
* **contracts:** Provider analysis outputs must explicitly supply metadata previously repaired with defaults; unsupported nullable facets must be reported as null.
* **javascript:** Semantic graph facts now store evidence context IDs and locations. Graph and semantic trace results require an inline evidence_contexts table.
* **contracts:** source-map URLs now live in target observations selected by declared_url_sha256, and doctor skill identity no longer emits installed_catalog_digest. Use the documented observation join and identity.skill.state instead.
* **javascript:** remove the never-incremented truncated_scopes statistic from JavaScript application analysis results and schemas.
* **native:** Objective-C attribute tokens now contain only name and value. Properties report nullable atomicity and readonly facts; class flags, ivar counts, and method requirement flags are nullable when unobserved.

### Features

* **setup:** register OMP during setup ([#1301](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1301)) ([8b4c359](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/8b4c3591358ee59297d8298ede1b63d08459d817))

body:
## [6.2.0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/compare/rea-agents-6.1.0...rea-agents-6.2.0) (2026-10-09)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

Read the [6.1 to 6.2 migration guide](docs/migration-6.2.md) before upgrading. REA's `always-bump-minor` policy includes breaking changes; 6.2 is not a backward-compatibility promise. Preserve original saved files and regenerate missing observations rather than fabricating identities or facts.

* **MCP / Evidence / snapshots / artifacts:** Success results are direct canonical Evidence; read `normalized_result` rather than the old `result`/`evidence` wrapper. Evidence requires nullable `analysis_profile`, session provider aliases are removed, snapshots require complete profile-bound query records, and artifact roles/permissions belong to occurrences. Recreate incompatible saved data; adding fields without recomputing their semantic identity is invalid. ([63bf914](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/63bf91405cf97b114a84f337fb1272d98a267999))
* **Process captures:** Legacy v3 conversion is removed. Explicit executable identity and `event_journal` are required; retain old captures and recapture when current comparisons are needed instead of inventing launch identity or event order. ([2a77469](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/2a7746998d47446c4db6d4f524e0f183d6803f3f))
* **Cleanup and evaluation:** A one-shot analysis reports cleanup failure while preserving the completed observation or primary diagnostic. Handle `cleanup_incomplete` and retained observations/resources. Configured agent-evaluation fixtures require Evidence-backed correctness, not routing or answer wording alone. ([#1211](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1211), [27a9cea](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/27a9ceade7232c1c9a24dc7d454ae060948183a1))
* **JavaScript:** Return-field projections require explicit presence; export-shape changes carry both sides' presence and property inventory coverage. Semantic object operations retain complete `property_path` segments. Regenerate old analysis and distinguish unknown values from unknown presence. ([475a0f8](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/475a0f84dac63d710e032bc7f731c1a3bda624ec))
* **Function comparisons:** Remove the unreachable `truncated` dimension state and `summary.truncated` counter; update enum and display consumers while retaining explicit `unknown` facts. ([5510b27](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/5510b27d7f863a3df26212fba4a59f8df0da3712))
* **Historical sources:** Unreadable/unknown symlink targets require `target: null`; external targets retain the observed absolute target. Reimport graphs containing display placeholders such as `<outside-root>` and handle nullable targets. ([b7b4333](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/b7b433370310c3ffe33d5027d8393151d5e862da))

name: v0.8.145
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.145

Released on 2026-10-10.

Studio can export on the GPU, and the producer package on npm is a fraction of its old size. Long exports no longer stall at 90%, and previews recover from a stalled font or asset.

## Features

- **Studio:** Export can encode on the GPU, like render --gpu ([91f9c9eb0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/91f9c9eb04619bfe5c43ccee1c87cad2f8a2f65a), [#5397](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5397)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** The npm package ships only its own code and no source maps ([affa4d53c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/affa4d53cf86334c18d0476955fce3f4f73f6a06), [#5398](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5398)).
- **Examples:** The k8s chunk-runner image installs and loads the producer again ([6f3f86a9c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6f3f86a9c9824c8ad5b7bf760375e243466e5ee0), [#5373](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5373)).

name: v0.8.144
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.144

Released on 2026-10-10.

Previews are steadier and the CLI is more reliable on Windows. Small previews keep every layer, a looping scene no longer plays past the film's end, and transcribe can write SRT or VTT directly.

## Features

- **CLI:** Let transcribe --to write srt or vtt straight from a media file ([908f4395b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/908f4395b4d05a3969bdc53a7cc89cea0d48e8ff), [#5215](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5215)).
- **CLI:** Models list shows which speech models transcribe can use ([0576b24c7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0576b24c75a604deb9c909407b8328b3df17b0c1), [#5323](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5323)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** Stop small previews dropping layers on heavy compositions ([5562c280d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5562c280daaad390625496aaefaa701d552c0612), [#5268](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5268)).
- **Studio:** The timeline viewport gate gives the same verdict on the same code ([2c082b3fe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c082b3fe5c9e12c0352198d30bfbbb8d9426b67), [#5361](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5361)).
- **Engine:** Recover audio duration by decoding the final frame ([9460c983e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9460c983e0ff6892d61dfebf1da6311b6c845548), [#3986](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3986)).
- **Core:** A data script in a sub-composition no longer stops every timeline ([e1b60933d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1b60933dbd257d54d74af32f3426ac2937caefb), [#5205](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5205)).
- **Lint:** Check passes valid sub-compositions and scene-relative asset paths ([5ec2dd2e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ec2dd2e121f25b45f3cc642504757970ed41027), [#5337](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5337)).
- **CLI:** Mirror skills into every installed agent on Windows ([ce73339b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce73339b1a1407237b133ff9e9398ae282919eb9), [#5367](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5367)).
- **CLI:** Renders on Windows stop cancelling when an old parent's pid is reused ([ce359d91c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce359d91cb6c765c5eee26098ce482ec87581956), [#5358](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5358)).
- **Studio:** A resized corner stays on the pointer when the size rounds to whole pixels ([6b341b0d8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b341b0d8458d5caf1e5c48c2f34d2fe671e911a), [#5213](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5213)).
- **CLI:** Name the unzip errors when every Windows unzip tool fails ([024107856](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0241078560f3846f1f825397bd137785db741ceb), [#5355](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5355)).
- **Studio Server:** The preview's proxy copy jumps queued thumbnails, and abandoned copies drop ([5eb2a96fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5eb2a96fc2747d92a0118103037b2903531479b7), [#5340](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5340)).
- **CLI:** Preserve subtitle cues across line endings ([9c1d3fbe6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9c1d3fbe622cb88702223bb5fdf443367f3ea90c), [#5223](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5223)).
- **CLI:** Undo complete timeline batch receipts atomically ([d03e41c9b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d03e41c9b4497bdb30f70fc79755848ec4b67c3e), [#5279](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5279)).
- **Studio:** Clip strips resize on the next frame, ending ResizeObserver loop errors ([a1803448b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a1803448b8b8fc5f9e38d78ad52ac43c18e08c40), [#5187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5187)).
- **Core:** Preview stops at the film's end when a scene loops forever ([cea48a548](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea48a548ab18c729ecb5314a0ed78a7507d5acd), [#5320](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5320)).
- **CLI:** Browser ensure fails when the unzip leaves no Chrome executable ([577bdf670](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/577bdf67013236e02fd5c8c1fc4c00905101ead2), [#5329](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5329)).
- **Sdk:** Correct animation calls in examples and docs ([a03d709a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a03d709a528fa5c0949fa73fd1a785da9aad4c44), [#5247](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5247)).
- **Studio:** Let small picks move when dragged by their middle ([7a84d29df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a84d29df100b37844ff2e62dde48de06bf70ede), [#5206](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5206)).

## Performance

- **Engine:** Wait for a missing composition timeline once per render, not once per browser ([e25394d38](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e25394d38e0d018bc9150f3c0798e44d7f924ff6), [#5227](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5227)).

## Docs & Examples

- Clarify async font measurement and timeline registration ([9e69821b8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e69821b8b188a6787c68d076a454eca9885d410), [#5203](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5203)).

## Catalog

- **Ci:** Keep the catalog publish PR when main changes nothing it generates ([7b85b2840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7b85b2840628d5362e029e7b390bd097060aaf55), [#5372](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5372)).
- **CLI:** Reject a swallowed --json when catalog's string flags have no value ([1de8b5ae3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1de8b5ae336041e6f0367b577c3870a7b2649f2c), [#3992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3992)).
- **Catalog:** Compare search vectors by direction so the publish PR can pass ([6ae1af747](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6ae1af7470133db72de6d9bbceeaf80e85695c68), [#5359](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5359)).
- **Registry:** Seven more WebGPU shader backgrounds, from sun burst to color wheel ([b05960008](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b0596000838d513200d64d6cad9ad0298d287785), [#5341](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5341)).
- **Registry:** Seven more WebGPU shader backgrounds, from ripples to thin film ([9dbbca745](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9dbbca7459d4951c14e46798166766eb5a84d010), [#5190](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5190)).
- **Registry:** Eight more WebGPU shader backgrounds, from blob to fractal noise ([46f6cb356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/46f6cb356785bed79e1ce7b79d7e7accc697786a), [#5192](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5192)).
- **Registry:** Eight more WebGPU shader backgrounds and a bundle with thirty new shaders ([63a7ec692](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63a7ec692f4a6bbdbcf39b68561fb197b233df32), [#5191](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5191)).

name: v2.2.0
body:
## v2.2.0 — 2026-10-10

### pm-execution

- **create-prd** is now lean by default: a first PRD is about one to two pages, with the detailed version on request. Feedback was that the skill fought itself, asking for a "comprehensive" document and for brevity at the same time. "Complete" now means no gap that blocks a decision about the first version; the section questions are a checklist to pick from rather than a form to fill; Market Segments and Value Propositions are always included; unknowns go to Assumptions and open questions instead of being invented; it asks up to three questions when the problem, the users, or the success metric is missing; it researches the market, competitors, and alternatives freely, citing sources, and puts a finding in the PRD only when it changes a decision; and it ends by naming what it left out so you can expand any section. The Value Proposition section now uses the 6-part JTBD template (Who, Why, What before, How, What after, Alternatives, by Paweł Huryn and Aatir Abdul Rauf), one per segment (two or three segments at most for a first version), and is the spine of the PRD: the Solution delivers its How and the Key Results measure its What after. It also gained a short checklist for reviewing an existing PRD.
- **`/write-prd`** now uses the create-prd template. It had carried its own, different 8-section template while also invoking the skill. It asks at most three questions up front.

### pm-ai-shipping

- Added the **code-review** skill: correctness is the core engine, with performance and security as optional sub-cases of it rather than separate methods. It anchors on agreements between participants across a boundary — the defects that stay invisible file-by-file because each side reads as reasonable alone — forces a violating execution, and refutes every candidate before reporting.
- Added a correctness taxonomy reference built from real fix history, plus performance and security reference sheets the same engine reads.
- `/ship-check` gained a correctness review as Step 3, before the security and performance audits, and an independent unsteered pass by a second model as Step 6.
- `/security-audit-static` gained an OWASP Top 10 coverage backstop: every surviving finding is mapped to a category, and any category with zero findings is flagged "not covered — double-check" rather than silently passing. It is a coverage check, not a mandate to invent findings.
- Docs, the test-coverage map and reports now follow the host repo's setup. Before writing, the kit reads the repo's agent instructions (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and what they import), its docs folder, and any existing equivalent of each document under any name; it updates those instead of creating parallel files and keeps their naming and date conventions. `documentation/`, `documentation/tests.md`, `reports/` and the default file names apply only where the repo has none, and the output says so. It never creates a file that differs from an existing one only in letter case (`tests.md` beside `TESTS.md`), which collides on Windows and macOS. The rule lives once, in the **shipping-artifacts** skill.
- `/ship-check` edits the agent instruction file the repo already uses. Where one of `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` only imports or points to the other (a `CLAUDE.md` that is just `@AGENTS.md`), it edits the file pointed to and leaves the pointer alone; where only one exists, it edits that one. `CLAUDE.md` plus a thin `AGENTS.md` is created only in a repo with neither.
- The independent review in `/ship-check` Step 6 is a fresh session of a model family different from the one that built the code, using the reviewer the repo's own instructions name. It no longer names a specific model as the usual choice.
- `/derive-tests` defers to the repo's stated gate policy. A repo whose instructions make the gate a local command plus a human go keeps that: the coverage map records the policy and whether the deterministic tests run inside it, instead of recommending hosted CI and branch protection over it. The green-before-merge CI gate remains the recommendation where the repo states no policy.
- `/derive-tests` writes into an existing file only when that file is a test-coverage map. A `TESTS.md` that describes the repo's testing method is no longer taken for the map just because of its name: the kit matches on what a file covers, uses the repo's real coverage map, and where there is none picks a name that collides with nothing, rather than writing into a same-named file about something else.
- `/document-app check` is a check-only mode for a repo that keeps its docs by hand as intent. It writes no file and reports each place where an existing doc and the code disagree: the doc says X, the code does Y, with `file:line` on both sides. It doesn't decide which side is wrong; the owner decides whether to fix the code or the doc. The output ends with a short summary a release checklist can cite.
- `/derive-tests check` does the same for the coverage map. It writes no file, reads the tests without running them, and reports rows that are stale against the docs or the test suite (a documented rule with no row, an "existing" row whose test is gone, a test the map doesn't credit), ending with the same kind of citable summary.
- `/security-audit-static` and `/performance-audit-static` can audit only a change: pass a git range (`/security-audit-static v2.1.0..HEAD`), `changes` for the uncommitted working tree, or both. The audit covers the changed files plus what the change makes newly reachable or newly wrong elsewhere, not the whole codebase. A release normally audits only its changes; a whole-repository audit, still the default with no argument, is for the first release or after a large refactor.

name: v0.45.0
body:
## New features

- Choose Español in Settings. Browsers set to Spanish use it on first load.
- Browse Junie CLI, OMO, and StepCode sessions with their usage and costs. Junie ingestion excludes tool calls and IDE-only conversations. If you previously used `PI_DIR` for OMO, remove that override to avoid indexing new sessions twice.
- Read Antigravity conversations from plaintext transcripts when no session database exists, without a decryption key. These transcripts include reasoning and tool calls but no token usage or cost.
- See commits, lines added and removed, and files changed on the dashboard for the selected dates. Load pull-request totals on demand after GitHub setup.
- Switch the Activity timeline between concurrency, user-message frequency, and assistant-message frequency.
- Compare user, assistant, and other message counts in the Analytics timeline with Absolute and Percent views. Other includes system entries and tool results.
- See all prompt tokens in the Usage page's Total Input card, including cache reads and writes. The previous Input Tokens count is labeled Uncached Input.
- Choose Smooth, Lines, or Bars for Cost Over Time. The chart remembers your choice, shows zero-spend days, and supports dragging to select a date range.
- Follow tool errors, retries, switches, and recovery in a session's tool sequences panel. Each step links to its transcript call and shows available timing and evidence. Opening the panel adds no token charges.
- Give Claude Code and Codex access to past conversations through native conversation-memory plugins. Session-start refresh and readiness diagnostics help identify missing setup or search coverage.
- Install proactive conversation recall with `agentsview skills install`. The package guides agents to search relevant history, distinguish proposals from accepted decisions, and cite transcript evidence.
- Approve or archive extracted entries in Recall, the collection of memories extracted from sessions. Review decisions survive later extraction changes.
- Activate the first Recall collection before the initial backlog finishes, once a session is complete and usable entries exist. Recent sessions extract first, and later passes add to the active collection.
- Extract Recall entries from several sessions at once by setting `concurrency` on an extraction server. The default remains 1.
- Choose the default CLI for generated insights with `[insights] default_agent`. Leaving it unset keeps Claude as the default.
- Replace selected ChatGPT or Claude.ai imports with `agentsview import --replace <session-id>`. The old transcript moves to Trash as a restorable copy, while the live session keeps its name and pins on matching messages.
- Identify refused ChatGPT and Claude.ai imports by session ID and reason. CLI summaries separate changed history, shorter exports, trashed sessions, and temporary failures.
- Use semantic and hybrid search on ClickHouse mirrors. Embeddings upload with `clickhouse push` when vector search is enabled; `--no-vectors` or `push_vectors = false` opts out.
- Browse hosted raw-sync uploads after the server parses them into PostgreSQL sessions. This opt-in mode removes the need for a local SQLite archive or a separate `pg push`.
- Upload existing sources in a finite, resumable run with `raw-sync backfill --run-id ID --provider NAME`. Start `raw-sync watch` after the run completes to upload later changes.
- Inspect hosted uploads and parsing with `raw-sync server-status` and the raw-sync health API. Run `raw-sync clean-uploads` to expire upload sessions and remove orphaned temporary files without starting the server.
- Serve AgentsView under a reverse-proxy subpath with `serve --base-path`. Keep `--public-url` origin-only.
- Search several literal terms within one user/assistant exchange over MCP on SQLite and PostgreSQL. Narrow results by session, branch, project, agent, or date.
- Read MCP search evidence from the same transcript revision, and continue reading messages beyond the previous 20,000-character limit. Revision checks report when the source changed.
- Build clients for multiple machines with host keys and session titles in search results, batch session lookup, and optional source size and archive-update metadata.

## Improvements

- Load Activity, Usage, and Analytics reports faster on ClickHouse with lower memory use. Opened past-day reports survive restarts, and new pushes refresh only changed sessions where possible. Upgraded deployments need a push to complete new report data and access to `system.parts` for serving.
- Load Tool Usage and Top Skills analytics faster on PostgreSQL, with less memory use on large archives.
- Load dashboard metadata with less database work on large SQLite archives. The first writable startup builds an index before serving, so that startup takes longer.
- Open Usage after a price update without waiting for a full cache rebuild. Only sessions using changed models rebuild, and rebuilding starts in the background. The first startup after upgrading rebuilds the usage cache once.
- Sync and rebuild large archives with less retained transcript data and less repeated processing. Fresh archives defer the conversation export index until the first export, and full resync removes the redundant stored copy of message text.
- Update Cursor IDE chats with less parsing and memory use. A database change reparses only chats whose saved documents changed.
- Keep file watching responsive on large Antigravity installs by skipping generated directory trees. Windows watchers also use smaller change buffers, reducing memory use.
- Build hourly `export day` and `export digest` reports faster, especially for long sessions.
- See the current sync stage, subagent-repair counts, and notices when a sync waits for another operation. Refresh controls show elapsed query time and a live request timeline.
- Load more Activity sessions as you scroll. New pages append to the table, and failed loads offer a retry.
- See agent-provided session titles consistently, with user-chosen names taking precedence. First-message previews retain the user's actual prompt.
- Read fuller Codebuff and Freebuff transcripts, including attachment markers, errors, and answers to agent questions. Nested agents appear as linked subagent sessions, and costs include every prompt's reported credits.
- See OpenCode tool durations from dispatch to result, including permission waits. Calls without a dispatch timestamp retain an unknown duration.
- Extract fewer Recall procedure entries from work an agent only proposed. Procedure extraction requires tool evidence in the relevant action window. Upgrading re-extracts existing sessions.
- Keep Recall vector and hybrid queries available while extraction adds entries. The index may trail by 256 changes by default; hybrid search still finds newer entries by keyword.
- Configure embedding endpoints with HTTPS for public IP addresses and without query strings. Builds leave documents pending when configuration, credentials, or server failures prevent embedding.
- Sync remote hosts over HTTP. SSH sync is removed; configure each remote with a daemon URL and token. Existing archived sessions remain available.
- Measure app opens, screen visits, core actions, and visible visit duration through the existing telemetry opt-out. Daily daemon activity counts at most once per installation per UTC day.
- Diagnose desktop startup and database delays with logs that show backend port selection, readiness results, stalled database checkpoints, and connection or write-lock waits.

## Bug fixes

- Build from a fresh Go module cache without a missing-dependency error.
- Re-import ChatGPT exports to append new messages, fill previously empty tool results, and restore truncated message text while preserving existing message IDs and pins.
- Keep saved Claude.ai turns when a stale export contains fewer messages. Shorter exports are refused unless you explicitly request replacement.
- View, search, and copy raw Codex and Grok tool inputs. Codex patch edits also appear in Recent Edits.
- Keep both transcripts when Gemini CLI or Cursor files share a session ID, instead of letting one overwrite the other.
- Read Claude subagent continuations saved under another parent session. Pi subagents in nested directories also appear and link to their parent when the recorded layout identifies it.
- Keep Claude messages from other sessions out of human prompt counts and session-title selection. The transcript labels them "Message from another session".
- Count workers launched by another agent as Subagents on Activity, rather than inflating the Interactive peak.
- Price Codex cache writes at the cache-write rate and estimate auto-review costs using GPT-5.6 Luna rates. Offline reports and exports also include pricing for GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Sol.
- Retain reported costs when model filters contain spaces between model names or are blank on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
- Count every message in term trends for time zones where daylight saving time skips local midnight.
- Remove permanently deleted sessions from semantic search on the next embedding build. Sessions removed by sync and later imported again receive embeddings again.
- Keep Cursor and Antigravity idle instead of repeatedly syncing unchanged SQLite databases.
- Show Cursor IDE sessions on the date of their earliest timestamped message.
- Update active Codex Desktop sessions on macOS within about 30 seconds, even without Codex history hints.
- Start background serving on macOS without hanging on permission prompts for external volumes. Enable `scan_protected_paths = true` to include Git details from those locations.
- Keep macOS file identities stable across reboots, avoiding repeated archive reparses. Upgrading performs one initial reparse and raw-source capture.
- Apply session-provider changes made in Settings without restarting the daemon. Separate push-watch processes still require a restart.
- Keep local sessions and reachable remotes syncing when another remote's hostname cannot resolve. Sync failures retain their actionable error details.
- Keep Linux servers discoverable after clock corrections, and let Windows startup progress update while commands read it.
- Detect same-size file replacements on Windows and sync Positron project changes when file timestamps stay the same.
- Open the desktop app against an authenticated local daemon without a readiness timeout. The app also recovers after an observed backend outage while hidden and avoids stale startup errors during an in-app update.
- Replace a served DuckDB mirror with `duckdb push` on Windows without stopping `duckdb serve`.
- Load current SQLite-backed OpenClaw sessions and discover Hermes Agent sessions in the default Windows location.
- Report incomplete Git and pull-request totals in `agentsview stats`, and wait beyond the former 30-second client timeout for slow results.
- Count repositories once across clones and worktrees, and count each commit once while retaining work from diverged branches.
- Clear the minimum-prompt filter by clicking its selected value again. Usage cards grow to contain wrapped text, and password-manager menus no longer cover typeahead search boxes.
- Refuse writable archives when the build cannot load their existing FTS5 index, with an error that explains how to fix the executable.

## beads v1.3.2-rc.2

Pre-compiled binaries for Linux, macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon), Windows (AMD64 & ARM64), Android/Termux (ARM64), and FreeBSD.

### Installation (release candidate)

> **This is a prerelease for validation.** The stable install channels —
> Homebrew, the `install.sh` / `install.ps1` scripts, npm, and PyPI —

go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.3.2-rc.2

name: v7.0.0
body:
We rebuilt brainstorming from scratch so it does a much better job of what it was always for: helping you work out what you actually want and put it into words before anything gets built. The new skill asks you to describe what you're after and why, plays back what it heard so you can correct it, and keeps asking good questions until the picture is clear. Then it matches the process to the work, from just doing it to writing a full design. 

This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace and fixes Windows hook discovery, Git Bash paths, Hermes skill descriptions, and several smaller bugs.

### Brainstorming

- **Brainstorming draws out what you want before it proposes anything.** Its first message offers to skip the questions and asks one open question about a real moment or a concrete picture. It offers a menu only when you're stuck. Along the way, it offers to look at prior art, your project, or the web. As it understands each part, it plays that part back in a few hundred words and marks its guesses as guesses. (#2463)
- **It sizes the work after it understands what you want, and says so in plain words.** It does a quick, clear task right away, agrees a small change with you in chat, and writes a design document for a project. You can override its call, and it steps up a size if the work grows. (#2463)
- **A builder check replaces the spec-document reviewer.** A fresh subagent reads the design as the person who'll build it and lists what they'd still need to ask. Brainstorming answers what it can, makes the minor calls itself and marks them as its own, and brings you the questions that change what gets built, in one round. (#2463)
- **It finds out which choices about how the thing gets made you want to own.** Platform, language, libraries, medium: if you have strong views, it talks them through; if you hand them over, it picks sensible defaults and tells you what it picked. It does this even when you skip the questions. We made this change after a session designed an iOS app, never asked about platform, and built a web app. (#2482, #2483)
- **It offers the visual companion whenever seeing would help more than reading:** screens, layouts, flows, options that look different, diagrams. The offer drops its token-cost warning. (#2463)
- **The visual companion now shows screens containing `$'`, `$&`, and similar sequences intact.** The server inserted content with `String.replace`, which treats those sequences as replacement patterns. It now inserts content literally. Thanks @andrew-yian for the report and @luochen211 for the fix. (#2362, #2364)

### Antigravity

- **`agy plugin install https://github.com/obra/superpowers` now installs Superpowers as a native Antigravity plugin.** We added `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json` with the Marketplace display name, logo, and suggested prompts. Previously, agy fell back to importing the repo as a Gemini CLI extension, then rejected the copied Claude-format hooks file on every session with `invalid hook "hooks": command hook must specify 'command'`. The install command stays the same. (#2479)
- **Superpowers bootstraps on Antigravity through skill discovery.** Antigravity has no session-start hook event, but it shows the model each installed skill's description, and `using-superpowers`' "Use when starting any conversation" prompts the model to load it. We verified this on agy 1.3.1 across 12 runs: "Let's make a react todo list" and "add a settings page" triggered brainstorming before any code, and a failing test triggered systematic-debugging before any edit. We also corrected the README and porting guide, which described a session-start hook and install script that never existed. (#2479)

### Hooks

- **SessionStart now works when the harness launches it with a broken `PATH`.** The hooks no longer look up `dirname`, `cat`, or `bash` on `PATH`, so a startup `PATH` that can't resolve them (anthropics/claude-code#43127) no longer drops the bootstrap. Thanks @kannan983 for the report and Ada Sen for the fix. (#2310, #2349)
- **Windows: `run-hook.cmd` finds per-user Git for Windows installs and skips WSL launchers.** It now checks `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Git`, and when it searches `PATH`, it skips the WSL `bash.exe` launchers, which fail without a Linux distro. Thanks @jp5247 for the report, and @citizen204 (#1864) and @KaiyiQuan (#2365) for the fixes we combined here. (#1863, #2393)
- **Windows: `run-hook.cmd` ignores `bash` and `where` in the current directory.** Previously, a repository could plant `bash.cmd` or `where.bat` and have it run at session start. (#2393)
- **Windows: `run-hook.cmd` now passes hook exit codes to the harness.** It used to report success even when the hook failed. (#2393)

### Subagent-Driven Development

- **`sdd-workspace` leaves a repo's own `.superpowers/sdd/.gitignore` alone.** It used to overwrite the file with `*` on every run, reverting any version a repo committed (for example, to track `progress.md` ledgers). It now writes the default only when no file exists. Thanks @aruizcu1989 for the fix. (#2161, #2399)
- **Plan markers stay repo-relative on Windows.** On Git Bash, `sdd-workspace` compared `git rev-parse`'s `C:/…` root with the plan's `/c/…` path, so every workspace marker recorded an absolute, machine-specific path. It now resolves the root the same way as the plan path. We found this while landing @t0domanh's Windows test fixes (#2149).

### Executing Plans

- **`task-done` now records tasks whose test command passes silently.** When a passing command printed nothing, `task-done` exited 1 without writing the ledger line, so a finished task looked unfinished. It now records `→ (no output)`. Thanks @KenM-BT for the report and Ada Sen for the fix. (#2385, #2388)

### Requesting Code Review

- **The example's base-SHA command survives skill arguments.** Claude Code replaces `$1` in a skill body with the second argument word, so invoking the skill with arguments turned `awk '{print $1}'` into `awk '{print <word>}'`. The example now uses `cut -d' ' -f1`, which contains no `$`. Thanks @errmakov for the report and @klemens-floege for the fix. (#2311, #2361)

### Systematic Debugging

- **The multi-layer diagnostic example no longer prints the secret it checks for.** `${IDENTITY:+SET}${IDENTITY:-UNSET}` and `env | grep IDENTITY` both echoed the signing identity's value into logs. The example now reports only whether the variable is set. Thanks @kennyg-g for the report and @m2dumpling for the fix. (#2375, #2380)

### Hermes Agent

- **Hermes' skill list now shows Superpowers skill descriptions.** Hermes lists each plugin skill with the description passed to `register_skill`, which defaults to empty. The plugin passed only a name and path, so every skill appeared blank and the model had nothing to choose from. The plugin now passes each skill's frontmatter description. Thanks @pepijn-blom for the fix. (#2284)

name: v5.1.29
body:
**Child tasks and Kibitzer wakes of a fast-mode session no longer fail with `model_unavailable`: a `-fast` pin is accepted when the session starts on its paired base model.** Since 5.1.25, a category pinned to a `-fast` catalog variant such as `chatgpt-subscription/gpt-6-luna-fast` was refused after start, because senpi starts a `-fast` pin on its base model with the priority tier. Kibitzer recall wakes failed on every wake, and the built-in fast-first chains (`quick`, `deep-low`, `deep-high`, `ultrabrain`) silently skipped their first model. A run that started on the standard tier instead of priority is now accepted and recorded on the task (`effective_model.service_tier`) instead of refused. ([#9793](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9793), [#9808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9808), [#9812](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9812), [#9813](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9813))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10-11.** `tool_schema("eval:environments")` now documents `packages.install` and its `environment_install_timeout`, so JavaScript and Python cells can discover how to install packages without changing the default eval description or parameters. Julia, Ruby and Python cells do less fixed work per cell: no globals walk below the memory thresholds, no awaited cwd stat, and leaner Python queue and capture bookkeeping. A scheduled prompt created in a desktop thread before the OmO desktop moved that folder now fires, and `--session`, `--resume` and `--continue` find such sessions in the folder's new home. A session another live process already holds is refused with a typed `session_held` error instead of being opened twice. Sessions that share MCP servers but resolve different MCP configs no longer break each other's tools. A goal whose continuation stops also stops its timer. On Windows, stopping a command's process tree can no longer kill an unrelated process that reused a pid. On macOS and Linux, processes a JavaScript eval cell starts get their own process group, so a group kill can't stop the agent, and leftover grandchildren are stopped when the cell ends. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-11](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-11). (code-yeongyu/senpi#3003, code-yeongyu/senpi#3028, code-yeongyu/senpi#3033, code-yeongyu/senpi#3034, code-yeongyu/senpi#2990, code-yeongyu/senpi#2951, code-yeongyu/senpi#2597, code-yeongyu/senpi#3007, code-yeongyu/senpi#2999, code-yeongyu/senpi#2995, code-yeongyu/senpi#3020, #9825)

### Fixed

**A background child no longer stays suspended while its parent is running.** A child parked while its parent session was still live was only revisited at the parent's next start, so it could sit suspended for hours and a goal waiting on its result waited forever. It is now revived right away, or ends with one result. ([#9350](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9350), [#9799](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9799))

**omo.dev shows its live stats more reliably.** A cold page load whose first stats refresh hit one upstream blip showed the fallback numbers; it now falls back to the last complete set instead. ([#9820](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9820), [#9821](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9821))

name: CC Switch v4.0.7
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.7

### 4.0 正式版的第三个修复版本

同一个 OpenAI 账号下的 Plus 和 Team 工作区，在 4.0 里切不过去，这个版本修好了。额度可以改回 3.x 那样显示「已用」，在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」里切换。Codex 的历史会话可以在 CC Switch 里打开压缩，会话管理和用量统计也能读取压缩后的会话。直连和路由互相切换后，CC Switch 也会提示重启 Codex；Windows 上第一次能看到这条提示。用量统计这次修了几处算错的地方，包括 Claude 1 小时缓存写入的价格和部分中转站的缓存命中。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.7-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.7-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**可以压缩 Codex 的历史会话。** Codex 会把每个会话完整记录在 `~/.codex/sessions` 下，用得多的话这个目录会涨到几十 GB。Codex 自己有一个还在开发中的压缩功能，默认关闭；CC Switch 这次加了开关，并且能读取压缩后的会话。

- **怎么打开：** 在「设置 → 应用配置 → Codex」打开「压缩 Codex 历史会话」，旁边会显示 `sessions` 和 `archived_sessions` 两个目录当前一共占多少空间。这个开关直接改 Codex 的 `config.toml`：打开时写入 `[features]` 下的 `local_thread_store_compression = true`，关闭时删掉这一行，CC Switch 不另外保存这个设置。
- **压缩什么时候发生：** 打开后不会马上压缩。Codex 每次启动时会在后台把 7 天以上没动过的会话文件压成同名的 `.jsonl.zst`，再删掉原文件。实测压缩后大约只占原来的六分之一。
- **继续旧会话：** 照常在 Codex 里继续就行，Codex 会先把这个会话解压回原来的格式。
- **在 CC Switch 里：** 压缩过的会话照常出现在会话列表里，可以查看和删除，用量照常统计，压缩前后也不会重复计算。为了在会话很多时也能很快打开列表，CC Switch 只读压缩文件的开头，所以这些会话不显示最后一条回复的预览，最后活跃时间取文件的修改时间。
- **需要注意：** 需要较新版本的 Codex，改完要重启 Codex 才生效。这是 Codex 还在开发中的功能，打开后 Codex 每次启动都会显示一条提示。关闭开关后不再压缩新的会话，已经压缩的会话保持原样，只有在 Codex 里继续时才会被解压。其他直接读取 `.jsonl` 会话文件的工具可能读不到压缩后的会话。

即使不打开这个开关，Codex 的后台服务也可能自己压缩会话。以前 CC Switch 只认未压缩的会话文件，这些会话会从会话列表里消失，用量也不会导入，现在都能正常读取。

**额度可以显示「已用」。** 4.0 把各档额度都改成了「剩余 x%」，有人习惯 3.x 的「已用 x%」，也有人希望和 Codex 自己的写法一致，所以做成了设置。在「设置 → 通用 → 外观 → 额度显示」选「剩余」（默认）或「已用」，供应商卡片、授权中心和托盘都会跟着变。只有各档的百分比会换，余额、Codex Credits 和重置次数始终显示剩余，用完的档位仍然显示「已用完」。颜色和「快用完」提醒仍然按剩余算，已用 94% 和剩余 6% 一样是橙色。展开后的进度条长度跟着显示的数字走，已用 30% 就画 30%。

**直连和路由互相切换后，也会提示重启 Codex。** 已经打开的 Codex 还在用启动时读到的模型列表。以前只在聚合模式下检查，直连和路由互相切换后，即使模型列表变了也不会提示。现在三种模式都会检查。关掉提示后如果模型列表又变了，提示会再次出现。

**Windows 上也能看到重启 Codex 的提示了。** 以前判断 Codex 有没有在运行，靠读系统进程列表，这个方法在 Windows 上用不了，模型列表和账号的提示都不会出现，重启按钮也总是说后台服务没在运行。现在 Windows 上按 Codex 后台服务自己记录的进程号判断它是否在运行，只在确认它在运行时提供重启按钮。CC Switch 在 Windows 上看不到 Codex 桌面版和编辑器插件，所以只要模型列表或登录账号和你上次关掉提示时不一样，就会提示「切换前就开着的 Codex 可能还在用之前的账号或模型列表」；这些客户端没开着的话，直接关掉提示就行。刚升级时不会弹出这条提示。

**从应用页菜单打开「配置目录」时，设置页会滚到这个应用的条目**，并让它的边框闪两下。滚动途中你自己滚动或点击，会马上停止；系统开启了减少动态效果时直接跳过去。

## 修复

- **同一个 OpenAI 账号下的 Plus 和 Team 工作区，在 Codex 里切不过去。** 4.0 只按用户来认 Codex 的官方登录，同一个人的不同工作区被当成「已经登录了这个账号」，`auth.json` 不会改写，也不会提示重启。暂存登录信息时也按用户记，同一个人的几个工作区只剩一份。现在按「用户 + 工作区」来认，和 Codex 自己判断账号有没有变的方式一致。升级后会自动整理暂存的登录信息，被合并掉的工作区会从官方卡片里找回来；已经登出的账号不会被恢复。
- **Codex 供应商的地址写在 `config.toml` 顶层时，编辑保存会把地址删掉。** 这类配置在编辑器里请求地址显示为空，保存后地址被删除，路由报「Codex Provider 缺少 base_url 配置」；直连模式下切过去还会走到 OpenAI 官方地址。现在会把顶层地址整理到 `[model_providers.custom]` 里，编辑器能显示，保存也会保留。表单也不再生成这种写法。
- **Windows 用户名里有中文等非 ASCII 字符时，在「应用」页升级工具失败**，提示「系统找不到指定的路径」。Claude Code 供应商卡片上的「打开终端」也会读不到临时配置，Claude Code 不报错，直接用默认配置启动；项目目录带中文时也一样。原因是 CC Switch 生成的批处理文件按 UTF-8 写入，`cmd.exe` 却按控制台代码页读。升级脚本现在会先切换到 UTF-8，这一步只在它自己的隐藏窗口里生效；「打开终端」不切换代码页（那会改掉你自己终端的设置），改为不把这些路径直接写进批处理文件。
- **Codex 在官方供应商下继续旧的第三方会话时，报错提示让你重启。** Codex 继续会话时会沿用会话创建时的供应商，第三方会话会一直指向本地路由，重启 Codex 也没用。现在报错会说明这是旧的第三方会话，需要新开会话；只有确实是 Codex 没有重新读取配置时，才提示重启。
- **Claude 的 1 小时缓存写入按 5 分钟的价格计费。** 1 小时缓存写入的单价是输入价的 2 倍，5 分钟的是 1.25 倍，以前一律按 5 分钟算，少算了不少。现在代理日志和 Claude Code 会话导入都会分开计价。
- **部分 OpenAI 兼容中转站的缓存命中显示为 0。** 有的中转站把 `cache_read_input_tokens` 固定写成 0，真实命中数放在 `prompt_cache_hit_tokens` 里，以前读到 0 就不往下找了，缓存命中显示为 0，未命中的输入也被多算。现在遇到 0 会接着看下一个字段。Claude Code 经路由转 OpenAI Chat 格式、Codex 和 Grok Build 使用 Chat 格式的上游时都按这个规则读。
- **Codex 会话导入的用量里没有缓存写入。** GPT-5.6 和 GPT-6 的缓存写入被按普通输入计价，现在会单独记录。
- **Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 的费用记为 0。** 内置定价表补上了这两个模型。
- **用量统计「Claude」页里，同一个供应商在 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 里都配置过时，会出现两行一样的记录**，切换应用后还会留下旧的行。
- **OpenCode 和 MiniMax Code 的额外选项，编辑其中一项后，其他没动过的值类型会变。** 比如字符串 `"123"`、`"false"` 被存成数字或布尔值。现在没改过的值保持原样，改名时也不能改成已有的名字。
- **OpenClaw 打开或关闭「发送 User-Agent」时，其他自定义请求头全被删掉。** 现在只改 User-Agent 这一项。
- **Pi 和 MiniMax Code 的「火山 Agent Plan」预设用的是 Coding Plan 的地址**，Agent Plan 的 Key 用不了。现在改用 Agent Plan 自己的地址，另外新增「火山 Coding Plan」预设。

**其他：**
- 中文版聚合模式指南和三语用户手册补充了两个 Codex 常见问题：子 agent 换到另一家供应商后读不到任务，以及官方 5 小时额度用完后 `/model` 被锁定在 Luna Reserve，暂时把第三方供应商设为默认可以绕开。
- 「统一 Codex 会话历史」的说明改为只针对 Codex CLI：Codex 桌面版更新后已经能显示所有供应商的会话，只用桌面版的话不需要打开。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

**Claude 的缓存写入费用升级后会变高。** 用 1 小时缓存时（Claude Code 主会话通常就是），新记录的缓存写入按正确的价格计算，每天的费用会比升级前高一截。这是以前少算了，不是涨价；升级前的记录不会重算。

**Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 以前记为 0 的费用**，会在启动时按新价格补算。Haiku 5.5 只按 10 万 token 以内的价格计算，更长的提示词会少算。

**已经添加过的「火山 Agent Plan」供应商（Pi、MiniMax Code）不会自动修改**，请把请求地址里的 `/api/coding/v3` 改成 `/api/plan/v3`，或者删掉后用新预设重新添加。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @ggbdpq（中转站缓存命中显示为 0、OpenCode 额外选项类型被改、直连和路由切换后的重启提示）、@Chaoqi31（报告并修复 Claude 1 小时缓存写入计价、Codex 会话导入缓存写入）、@Yanxcyan（Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 定价、火山 Agent Plan 预设）、@hulkbig（报告并修复 OpenClaw 自定义请求头被删）、@Railgun-wiki（报告并修复用量统计重复行）、@funkpopo（设置页滚到应用配置条目）的贡献。

感谢 @yleo888、@harvey500、@friendlzw、@burningimlam、@JinLin-Yu、@winter-maple、@SamPheng、@cjmarklll、@LeenixP、@EMnian 报告问题和提出建议。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.5.0-beta.9 -->

- https://github.com/marc2332/freya/commit/063f5e8b7753760dc534b1fc1084d6be83782ce7

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/marc2332/freya/compare/v0.5.0-rc.9...v0.5.0-beta.9

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-09.

uv 0.13.0 makes Python 3.15 the default stable Python version. We've also included several breaking changes to improve correctness, performance, and compatibility, described below.

**We expect most users to be able to upgrade without making changes.**

While not a breaking change, this release also updates the format of many of uv's cache entries to improve performance. **uv may download or rebuild dependencies after upgrading**, because some cached entries from earlier versions cannot be reused. Multiple versions of uv can still safely share the same cache directory.

There are no breaking changes to the configuration of the [uv build backend](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/build-backend/). If your `[build-system]` table includes an upper bound on `uv_build`, update it to allow `uv_build` 0.13, e.g., `uv_build>=0.13.0,<0.14`.

### Breaking changes

- **Use Python 3.15 as the default stable version**

  The default stable Python version has changed from 3.14 to 3.15. This affects Python downloads when no version is requested or pinned, e.g., when running `uv python install`.

  uv continues to use compatible Python installations that are already present. For example, `uv venv` can still use an installed Python 3.14. If no suitable interpreter is installed and automatic downloads are enabled, commands such as `uv venv` and `uvx python` can now download Python 3.15.

  You can opt out of this behavior by requesting Python 3.14 explicitly, e.g., `uv venv --python 3.14`. For projects, use `uv python pin 3.14` to record the version in `.python-version`.

- **Honor `--require-hashes` in included constraints files** ([#22275](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22275))

  Previously, uv ignored `--require-hashes` in constraints files included with `-c` from a requirements file. Now, uv honors the directive and requires hashes for all requirements in the installation. Installs that previously succeeded can now fail if a requirement is missing a hash.

  You cannot opt out while the directive is present. Add the missing hashes to your requirements, or remove the `--require-hashes` directive from the included constraints file if hash checking is not intended.

- **Prefer native Python on Windows ARM64** ([#22100](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22100))

  Previously, ARM64 builds of uv preferred emulated `x86_64` Python installations because native wheel support was limited. Now, uv prefers native ARM64 (`aarch64`) interpreters across Python versions.

  This follows similar changes in [CPython](https://discuss.python.org/t/python-on-windows-arm64/104524), the official Windows [Python install manager](https://discuss.python.org/t/python-install-manager-26-4/108846), and GitHub's [actions/setup-python](https://github.com/actions/setup-python#supported-architectures).

  When a native interpreter is unavailable, uv continues to fall back to `x86_64`, then 32-bit `x86`.

  You can opt out of this behavior by setting `UV_PYTHON_ARCH=x86_64` or requesting an explicit architecture, e.g., `cpython-3.14-windows-x86_64`. If you are using `setup-uv`, you can set [`python-arch: x86_64`](https://github.com/astral-sh/setup-uv#python-architecture) instead.

- **Reject editable requirements in included constraints files** ([#22282](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22282))

  Previously, uv silently ignored editable (`-e`) requirements in constraints files included with `-c` from a requirements file. Now, uv rejects these requirements with an error, matching [pip's behavior](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/user_guide/#constraints-files).

  You cannot opt out of this behavior. Move editable requirements to a requirements file passed with `-r`, or pass them directly with `--editable`, instead of including them in a constraints file.

- **Omit the distutils startup patch on Python 3.10 and later** ([#22096](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22096))

  Previously, uv installed `_virtualenv.py` and `_virtualenv.pth` into every new virtual environment to prevent distutils configuration from changing installation paths. Now, like [`virtualenv` 21.6.0](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/releases/tag/21.6.0), uv omits these files on Python 3.10 and later, which already ignore the affected configuration keys. This reduces Python startup overhead. Python 3.9 and earlier retain the patch.

  You cannot opt out of this behavior. Existing virtual environments are not modified automatically. Recreate an environment with Python 3.10 or later to remove the patch.

  This stabilizes the `no-distutils-patch` preview feature.

- **Treat requirement-file option values as single paths** ([#22290](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22290))

  Previously, uv split values passed to `--constraint`, `--override`, `--exclude`, and `--build-constraint` on spaces, even when quoted. Now, each value is treated as a single path, allowing file paths containing spaces.

  You cannot opt out of this behavior. Repeat the option to provide multiple files. For example, replace `-c "a.txt b.txt"` with `-c a.txt -c b.txt`.

  Space-separated lists in `UV_CONSTRAINT`, `UV_OVERRIDE`, `UV_EXCLUDE`, and `UV_BUILD_CONSTRAINT` remain supported.

- **Use `tar-codec` for tar archives by default** ([#22094](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22094))

  Previously, uv used `astral-tokio-tar` to extract tar archives, build source distributions with `uv_build`, and read their metadata for `uv publish`. Now, uv uses `tar-codec`, which applies stricter validation when reading archives.

  uv may now reject archives containing hard links or unsupported tar extensions that previous versions accepted. Source distributions created by `uv_build` can also have different archive bytes and hashes.

  You can opt out of this behavior by setting `UV_LEGACY_TAR_BACKEND=1`.

  This stabilizes the `tar-codec` preview feature.

- **Reject `uv build --clear` output directories that contain a build source**
  ([#22276](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22276))

  Previously, `uv build --clear` could delete a project or input source distribution when the
  output directory contained the source. Now, uv rejects these output directories, including
  equivalent paths reached through symlinks, before clearing any build output.

  Select an output directory that does not contain any build sources, or omit `--clear`.

### Python

- Add CPython 3.15.0 ([#22400](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22400))

### Preview features

- Require hashes for build dependencies, including transitive dependencies, with `--require-build-hashes` ([#21411](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21411))

### Performance

- Speed up revalidation of cached HTTP responses by avoiding rewrites of unchanged payloads ([#22130](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22130))
- Reduce allocations when reading cached HTTP responses ([#22136](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22136))
- Reduce cache storage for HTTP policies and package records ([#22135](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22135), [#22133](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22133))
- Reduce allocations for cached source distribution revisions ([#22131](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22131))

### Bug fixes

- Avoid overlong wheel cache lock filenames on Windows ([#22134](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22134))

## Install uv 0.13.0

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.0/uv-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.0/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

name: v0.5.0
body:
# OpenViking v0.5.0

## 中文

### OpenViking Gateway（Beta）

本版本新增 OpenViking Gateway（OpenViking 网关），因此升级到 0.5。任何能改 base URL 的模型客户端，接入网关后都能用上 OpenViking 记忆，不用装插件，也不用改代码或 prompt（#5625）。该功能在 PR 中名为 Context Gateway，发布前已改名（#5795）。

- 接入方式：网关是独立进程 `openviking-gateway`（默认端口 `1935`），位于客户端和模型服务之间。客户端只改两项：base URL 指向网关，模型服务的 API key 换成网关 key。网关支持 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Chat Completions 和携带完整历史的 OpenAI Responses，按原协议转发给配置的上游（upstream），不在协议之间转换（#5625）。
- 记忆注入：会话开头加入用户 profile 以及记忆、skill 目录；每条新用户消息先检索 OpenViking，再把相关记忆附在这条消息末尾。之后的请求会逐字节回放已注入的内容，provider 的 prompt cache 和 Claude thinking 签名因此保持有效（#5625）。
- 保存与压缩：对话保存到 OpenViking session（名为 `gateway-…`），由 OpenViking 抽取新记忆；网关新建的 session 关闭 Working Memory。对话接近模型上下文窗口（默认 90%）时，由同一模型写一份有长度上限的摘要，替换切点之前的历史（#5625）。
- OpenViking 工具：网关自己执行 OpenViking MCP 工具（名称加 `openviking_` 前缀），三种协议都支持，客户端无需声明这些工具。新建的 context profile 默认只勾选只读工具；`remember`、`write`、`edit`、`add_resource`、`add_skill`、`forget`、`set_acl` 等会改数据的工具需要管理员手动勾选。DeepSeek、Ark、BytePlus 上游默认开启 reasoning 回放，带工具的请求可以保持 thinking 开启（#5625）。
- 工具循环默认不设上限：网关内部的 OpenViking 工具循环默认不限轮数、总时长和 token，模型可以一直调用工具直到完成，流式请求中用户可随时中止。context profile 中的 `tool_max_rounds`、`tool_total_seconds`、`tool_total_tokens` 默认为空（不限），需要时可设上限；单次调用超时 `tool_timeout_seconds`（30 秒）不变。非流式客户端断开后循环不会停止，这类场景建议设置 `tool_total_seconds`（#5811）。
- 管理：Studio 新增 Gateway 页面（Overview、Upstreams、Profiles、Keys、Requests、Connect），账号管理员在这里管理上游、context profile 和网关 key；服务端新增管理代理 `/api/v1/admin/gateway/*`，删除用户或账号时会一并清除网关数据（#5625）。Connect 页为 pi、OpenCode、DSH 按协议分别生成配置，新增 DSH，并修正 pi 的 `apiKey` 写法（#5705）。
- 可选项：context profile 新增 `show_recall`（默认关闭），开启后每轮第一条回复开头显示本轮注入了哪些 OpenViking 内容，这段摘要不发给模型、也不存入记忆（#5751）。实验性的 agent 自管上下文窗口（`agent_windows`）中，hard reminder 改为每一步都提醒，直到模型新开窗口或触发压缩（#5707）。
- 部署：pip extras `gateway`、`gateway-fast`；Docker 镜像内置网关；Docker Compose 新增 `gateway` profile；Helm chart 升到 `0.2.0`，用 `gateway.*` 启用 sidecar（#5625、#5795）。启动前在 `ov.conf` 的 `gateway` 段设置 `enabled: true`，并提供环境变量 `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY`（Fernet key）和 `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN`（至少 32 个字符）。OpenViking Gateway 与 VikingBot Gateway（`vikingbot gateway`）是两个不同的组件（#5795）。

### 亮点

- Working Memory 改为默认关闭：commit 仍归档原始消息并抽取长期记忆，但默认不再生成 archive overview 和 checkpoint 摘要；commit 接口新增 `enable_working_memory`，可按次开启（#5696）。Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、pi、OpenClaw 等插件默认改由宿主自己管理历史和压缩，VikingBot 仍使用 OpenViking 管理上下文（#5686）。升级要点见「兼容性与迁移」第 1 条。
- 检索与召回：context 模式召回不再返回 `viking://resources` 等系统预置目录，各类别 quota 用不满的名额由其他类别的结果补上（#5679）；`exclude_uris` 传目录时排除整棵子树（#5627）；session 搜索时显式传入的 `context_type` 不再被 planner 改掉（#5549）；修复 v0.4.22 起图片检索一律报 `Image search requires a multimodal embedding model.` 的问题（#5644）；本地 GGUF embedding 并发调用加锁，修复 v0.4.22、v0.4.23 中索引与召回重叠时的崩溃（#5548）。
- Session 与记忆抽取：Working Memory 生成失败时 commit 任务重新标记为失败，不再写入占位摘要（#5624）；模型返回非字符串的 section 更新内容时保留原内容（#5516）；服务关闭导致的取消不再把排队中的 commit 标记为失败（#5591）；抽取结果的字段与 schema 完全不匹配时触发格式重试，不再当作空结果（#5731）；case overview 缺字段时回退到文件名（#5735）；Markdown frontmatter 按 YAML 解析，只用顶层字符串 `title` 命名文档（#5734）；MCP `remember` 改为报告「已提交抽取」并返回 `task_id`（#5678）。
- Agent 插件：Claude Code memory 插件在回答下方显示 OpenViking 来源卡片，默认折叠，`/openviking-usage expand|collapse` 切换，桌面端同样可用（#5653、#5663、#5664、#5694）；Codex 插件内置 OV-Usage 来源汇总，可在 `ovcli.conf` 中用 `usageView` / `usageOutput` 配置（#5699、#5738）；Claude Code、Codex、DSH、OpenCode、pi 的 commit 改为归档全部消息（#5459）；DSH 只在真实用户输入时召回（#5647），接受全部 0.x 版本（#5733），session ID 规范化以兼容 Windows 路径（#5522）；OpenCode 修复会话结束时重复发送同一批消息（#5674）；OpenClaw 自动上下文注入用户 profile（#5676）；Kimi Code 采集保留用户轮次（#5677）；Cursor、TRAE、ZCode hook 在宿主超时内结束，doctor 的超时检查改查正确的配置项（#5467）；Windows 上斜杠形式的 `bypassSessionPatterns` 能正确匹配（#5737）；共享 HTTP 客户端、OpenClaw 和 pi experimental 客户端在响应体被截断时按失败处理，不再当作空的成功结果（#5661、#5790）；LangChain 修复 capture state 类型（#5717）。
- Hermes：外部 provider 新增 Quick Local，复用 Hermes 已配置的 LLM，在私有运行环境中运行 OpenViking 和本地 BGE embedding，并提供 `hermes openviking local status/start/stop/restart`（#5465）；setup 时安装最新的兼容版本并校验 PyPI 摘要（#5710）；区分底层 LLM 错误类型（#5643）；同一 session 按顺序上传（#5641）；autostart 启动的服务端不再继承无关的 Hermes 密钥（#5706）；去掉通用 session-end hook 声明，消除 `plugins doctor` 误报（#5736）。
- Studio、CLI 与 VikingBot：Studio 的 Playground 改名为 Filesystem，旧 `/playground` 链接自动跳转到 `/filesystem`（#5681）；Studio API 对缺失的 Compile 任务 source 列表做规范化（#5611）；`ov status`、`ov config` 改为与 `OPENVIKING_CLI_CONFIG_FILE` 选中的配置文件保持一致（#5551）；修复 v0.4.23 Windows wheel 中 `ov` 报告 `0.4.24.dev0` 的问题（#5588）；`vikingbot chat` 新增可重复的 `--disable-tool`，LoCoMo 评测只保留 OpenViking 检索工具（#5761）；VikingBot 召回时，作为回退使用的事件摘要也计入事件和总字符预算（#5817）。
- 服务端与 SDK：embedding 服务对单个请求返回 400 时，只让这次请求失败，不再打开整个账号的 embedding 熔断器；超时、5xx、429 和配额错误仍按原样触发熔断（#5822）；Volcengine KMS 写入失败时清除缓存的根密钥，避免数据用未落盘的密钥加密（#5561）；QueueFS worker 关闭事件循环前先关闭其异步客户端，减少关停时的报错和耗时（#5675）；Python 客户端保留服务端返回的结构化错误详情，例如 `details.retryable`（#5559）；目录打包失败时清理残留的临时压缩包（#5557）。
- 文档与品牌：文档站按 Quickstart、Concepts、Agents、Develop、Deploy、Reference、Community 重组导航（#5583）；CLI 设置页拆成可复制的 agent prompt 和手动步骤（#5621）；历史设计稿中仍适用的内容迁入用户文档（#5512）；L0/L1 字符预算说明、Working Memory 升级指南及其他文档修正（#5529、#5690、#5700、#5703、#5704）；E 标志更新（#5743）；文档站与发布构建修复（#5569、#5574、#5576、#5584、#5585、#5586、#5600、#5634、#5708、#5749）。

### 兼容性与迁移

1. **Working Memory 默认关闭（#5696、#5686）**：`memory_policy.working_memory.enabled` 默认值由 `true` 改为 `false`。commit 仍归档原始消息并抽取长期记忆，但不再生成 archive overview 和 retention checkpoint 摘要。
   - 旧版本序列化策略时会省略值为 `true` 的 `working_memory` 字段，所以之前在 Studio 或 user/session 接口中显式开启过的策略，升级后也可能被当作 `false`。需要 Working Memory 的部署请重新显式开启。
   - 升级前已进入队列的旧任务仍按提交时的语义（Working Memory 开启）执行，升级后可能继续生成摘要。不希望出现这种情况时，升级前先等队列清空。
   - `POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/commit` 新增 `enable_working_memory`（`true` / `false` / `null`），只覆盖本次 commit 的 Working Memory 设置，其他策略字段不变；传字符串或数字会被拒绝。响应中的 `effective_enable_working_memory` 表示本次实际生效的值。
   - Working Memory 关闭时完成的 archive，`GET /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/archives/{archive_id}` 返回原始 `messages`，`overview` 和 `abstract` 为空字符串。
   - 升级 OpenViking Python 包不会更新已安装在各宿主中的插件，插件需要单独升级。新版插件的默认行为如下；已有的显式配置和环境变量仍然优先。

   | 集成 | 新默认 | 显式开启 |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | Claude Code、Codex / TraeCode CLI、OpenCode | 恢复会话或压缩时不自动注入 archive，历史由宿主管理 | `resumeArchiveInject: true` |
   | pi 官方扩展 | 使用 pi 原生压缩，不接管历史 | `takeoverEnabled: true` |
   | OpenClaw | `contextManagementMode: "native"` | `contextManagementMode: "openviking"` |
   | VikingBot | 仍由 OpenViking 管理上下文（`session_context_enabled: true`），commit 显式请求 Working Memory | `session_context_enabled: false` 切回本地模式 |

   ```bash
   # 单次 commit 开启 Working Memory
   curl -X POST "$OV_URL/api/v1/sessions/$SID/commit" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"enable_working_memory": true}'
   ```

2. **插件 commit 归档全部消息（#5459）**：Claude Code、Codex、DSH、OpenCode 和 pi（非接管模式）的 commit 改为发送 `keep_recent_count: 0`，`commitKeepRecentCount` / `OPENVIKING_COMMIT_KEEP_RECENT_COUNT` 不再被读取。以前每次 commit 都会留下最新 10 条消息不归档，10 条以内就结束的短会话不会被归档和抽取。服务端按全部 live 消息计算 `pending_tokens`，基于 token 阈值的 commit 会比以前稍早触发。

3. **Context 模式召回结果变化（#5679、#5627）**：`/api/v1/search/search` 在 `mode: "context"` 下不再返回系统预置目录（`viking://resources`、`viking://agent` 及其子目录、用户根目录及其一级目录）；各类别 quota 先作为上限，用不满的名额由其他类别的最佳结果补足，总数不变，quota 为 `0` 仍表示关闭该类别。`exclude_uris` 传目录 URI 时改为排除整棵子树，以前按字符串精确匹配，传目录实际什么都不排除。同一查询返回的条目可能与 v0.4.23 不同。

4. **MCP `remember` 返回文本变化（#5678）**：以前固定返回 `Stored N message(s) and committed for memory extraction.`；现在返回「已提交 N 条消息进行抽取」并附 `task_id`，没有生成任务时说明未提交的原因。抽取在后台进行，可能不产生记忆。解析旧返回文本的调用方需要更新。OpenClaw `memory_store` 在没有抽取出记忆时重新返回 `action: "failed"`、`error: "no_memories_extracted"`。

5. **CLI 配置管理跟随选中的配置文件（#5551）**：设置了 `OPENVIKING_CLI_CONFIG_FILE` 时，`ov status`、`ov config validate`、配置向导和配置管理都以该文件为准。命名 profile 在该文件所在目录查找，`ov config switch` 写入该文件，不再改默认文件；被选中的命名文件不能删除或重命名。要管理默认配置，请先 unset 该变量。

6. **DSH 插件（#5522、#5733）**：含 Windows 非法字符或以点、空格结尾的 DSH session ID 会被规范化并加上哈希后缀；这类旧会话升级后会对应新的 OpenViking session，已经合法的 ID 映射不变。插件的 DSH peer 依赖范围放宽为 `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <1.0.0-0`。

7. **Hermes Quick Local 版本范围（#5710）**：Quick Local setup 安装 `openviking[local-embed]>=0.4.22,<0.5`，重新运行 setup 会安装最新的 0.4.x，不会装 0.5.0。

## English

### OpenViking Gateway (Beta)

This release adds OpenViking Gateway, which is why the version moves to 0.5. Any model client that lets you change its base URL gets OpenViking memory through the gateway, with no plugin to install and no code or prompt to change (#5625). The feature was called Context Gateway in its PRs and was renamed before release (#5795).

- How clients connect: the gateway is a separate process, `openviking-gateway` (default port `1935`), between the client and the model provider. The client changes two settings: the base URL points at the gateway, and the provider API key is replaced with a gateway key. The gateway speaks Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions and full-history OpenAI Responses, forwards each request to a configured upstream in the same protocol, and never converts between protocols (#5625).
- Memory injection: a conversation starts with the user profile and the memory and skill catalogs; for each new user message the gateway searches OpenViking and appends the relevant memory to that message. Later requests replay the added content byte for byte, so provider prompt caches and Claude thinking signatures stay valid (#5625).
- Saving and compaction: conversations are saved to OpenViking sessions (named `gateway-…`), and OpenViking extracts new memories from them; sessions the gateway creates have Working Memory turned off. When a conversation nears the model's context window (90% by default), the same model writes a bounded summary that replaces the history before the cut (#5625).
- OpenViking tools: the gateway runs OpenViking MCP tools itself (with an `openviking_` prefix) for all three protocols, so the client does not need to declare them. New context profiles enable only the read-only tools; tools that change data, such as `remember`, `write`, `edit`, `add_resource`, `add_skill`, `forget` and `set_acl`, must be checked by an admin. Reasoning replay is on by default for DeepSeek, Ark and BytePlus upstreams, so requests that carry tools can keep thinking on (#5625).
- No default limits on the tool loop: the gateway's hidden OpenViking tool loop has no round, total-time or token limit by default, so the model keeps using OpenViking tools until it finishes, and in a streaming request the user can stop the reply at any time. The context profile fields `tool_max_rounds`, `tool_total_seconds` and `tool_total_tokens` default to empty (no limit) and can still be set to cap the loop; the per-call timeout `tool_timeout_seconds` (30 s) is unchanged. A non-streaming loop keeps running after the client disconnects, so set `tool_total_seconds` for non-streaming clients (#5811).
- Management: Studio adds a Gateway section (Overview, Upstreams, Profiles, Keys, Requests, Connect) where account admins manage upstreams, context profiles and gateway keys; the server adds the admin proxy `/api/v1/admin/gateway/*`, and deleting a user or account also purges its gateway data (#5625). The Connect page generates per-protocol setup for pi, OpenCode and DSH, adds DSH, and fixes the pi `apiKey` snippet (#5705).
- Options: context profiles add `show_recall` (off by default); when on, the first reply of each user turn starts with a short summary of what OpenViking added to that turn, which is never sent to the model or stored in memory (#5751). In the experimental agent-managed context windows (`agent_windows`), the hard reminder now repeats on every step until the model starts a new window or compaction runs (#5707).
- Deployment: pip extras `gateway` and `gateway-fast`; the Docker image includes the gateway; Docker Compose adds a `gateway` profile; the Helm chart moves to `0.2.0` and enables the sidecar through `gateway.*` (#5625, #5795). Before starting it, set `enabled: true` in the `gateway` section of `ov.conf` and provide the environment variables `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (a Fernet key) and `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN` (at least 32 characters). OpenViking Gateway and VikingBot Gateway (`vikingbot gateway`) are different components (#5795).

### Highlights

- Working Memory is now off by default: commits still archive raw messages and extract long-term memories, but no longer generate archive overviews or checkpoint summaries by default; the commit API adds `enable_working_memory` to opt in per commit (#5696). Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi, OpenClaw and other plugins now leave history and compaction to the host by default, while VikingBot keeps OpenViking-managed context (#5686). See item 1 under Compatibility and Migration.
- Retrieval and recall: context-mode recall no longer returns preset system directories such as `viking://resources`, and slots a category's quota leaves unused go to results from other categories (#5679); a directory in `exclude_uris` excludes its whole subtree (#5627); an explicit `context_type` in session search is no longer overridden by the planner (#5549); image search no longer always fails with `Image search requires a multimodal embedding model.`, a regression since v0.4.22 (#5644); calls into a shared local GGUF embedding context are serialized, fixing the v0.4.22 and v0.4.23 crash when indexing and recall overlap (#5548).
- Sessions and memory extraction: a failed Working Memory creation call fails the commit task again instead of writing a placeholder summary (#5624); a section whose update content is not a string keeps its previous content (#5516); cancellations caused by service shutdown no longer mark queued commits as failed (#5591); extraction results whose keys match none of the schema fields trigger a format retry instead of counting as an empty result (#5731); case overviews fall back to the file name when fields are missing (#5735); Markdown frontmatter is parsed as YAML and only a top-level string `title` names the document (#5734); MCP `remember` now reports the messages as submitted for extraction and returns the `task_id` (#5678).
- Agent plugins: the Claude Code memory plugin shows OpenViking source cards under answers, collapsed by default and toggled with `/openviking-usage expand|collapse`, in both the terminal and the desktop app (#5653, #5663, #5664, #5694); the Codex plugin adds built-in OV-Usage source summaries, configurable with `usageView` / `usageOutput` in `ovcli.conf` (#5699, #5738); commits from Claude Code, Codex, DSH, OpenCode and pi archive every message (#5459); DSH recalls only on real user input (#5647), accepts every 0.x release (#5733), and normalizes session IDs for Windows-safe storage paths (#5522); OpenCode no longer sends the same message batch twice at session end (#5674); OpenClaw injects the user profile into automatic context (#5676); Kimi Code captures keep the user turn (#5677); Cursor, TRAE and ZCode hooks finish within their host timeouts, and the doctor checks the right settings (#5467); slash-form `bypassSessionPatterns` match on Windows (#5737); the shared HTTP client and the OpenClaw and pi experimental clients treat a response body cut off after the headers as a failure instead of an empty success (#5661, #5790); LangChain capture state typing is fixed (#5717).
- Hermes: the external provider adds Quick Local, which reuses the LLM configured in Hermes and runs OpenViking with local BGE embeddings in a private runtime, with `hermes openviking local status/start/stop/restart` (#5465); setup installs the latest compatible release and verifies it against the PyPI digest (#5710); underlying LLM errors are classified correctly (#5643); uploads within a session keep their order (#5641); servers started by autostart no longer inherit unrelated Hermes secrets (#5706); the generic session-end hook declaration is removed, which silences a `plugins doctor` false positive (#5736).
- Studio, CLI and VikingBot: Studio's Playground is renamed Filesystem, and old `/playground` links redirect to `/filesystem` (#5681); the Studio API normalizes missing Compile task source lists (#5611); `ov status` and `ov config` follow the file selected by `OPENVIKING_CLI_CONFIG_FILE` (#5551); the v0.4.23 Windows wheel's `ov` reporting `0.4.24.dev0` is fixed (#5588); `vikingbot chat` adds a repeatable `--disable-tool`, and LoCoMo evaluation keeps only the OpenViking retrieval tools (#5761); in VikingBot recall, event summaries used as fallbacks now count toward the events and total character budgets (#5817).
- Server and SDK: an HTTP 400 from the embedding provider for a single request now fails only that request and no longer opens the account-wide embedding circuit breaker, while timeouts, 5xx, 429 and quota errors still trip it as before (#5822); when Volcengine KMS fails to persist a new root key, the cached key is cleared so data is not encrypted under a key that was never saved (#5561); QueueFS workers close their async clients before closing the event loop, cutting shutdown errors and delay (#5675); the Python client keeps structured error details from the server, such as `details.retryable` (#5559); partial temporary archives are removed when directory packing fails (#5557).
- Docs and branding: the docs site navigation is reorganized into Quickstart, Concepts, Agents, Develop, Deploy, Reference and Community (#5583); the CLI setup page is split into a copyable agent prompt and manual steps (#5621); still-relevant content from historical design notes moves into the user docs (#5512); L0/L1 character budgets, the Working Memory upgrade guide and other doc fixes (#5529, #5690, #5700, #5703, #5704); refreshed E logo (#5743); docs site and release build fixes (#5569, #5574, #5576, #5584, #5585, #5586, #5600, #5634, #5708, #5749).

### Compatibility and Migration

1. **Working Memory off by default (#5696, #5686):** the default of `memory_policy.working_memory.enabled` changes from `true` to `false`. Commits still archive raw messages and extract long-term memories, but no longer generate archive overviews or retention checkpoint summaries.
   - The previous serializer omitted `working_memory` when it was `true`, so a policy explicitly enabled through Studio or the user/session APIs may now resolve to `false`. Deployments that need Working Memory should enable it again explicitly.
   - Tasks queued before the upgrade keep their submission-time meaning (Working Memory on) and can still generate summaries after the upgrade. If that is not acceptable, drain the queue before upgrading.
   - `POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/commit` adds `enable_working_memory` (`true` / `false` / `null`), which overrides Working Memory for that commit only and leaves the other policy fields unchanged; strings and numbers are rejected. The response field `effective_enable_working_memory` reports the value actually used.
   - For an archive completed with Working Memory off, `GET /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/archives/{archive_id}` returns the raw `messages` with empty-string `overview` and `abstract`.
   - Upgrading the OpenViking Python package does not update plugins installed in agent hosts; upgrade them separately. New plugin defaults are below; existing explicit settings and environment variables still take priority.

   | Integration | New default | Explicit opt-in |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | Claude Code, Codex / TraeCode CLI, OpenCode | No automatic archive injection on resume or compaction; the host keeps history | `resumeArchiveInject: true` |
   | pi official extension | Native pi compaction, no takeover | `takeoverEnabled: true` |
   | OpenClaw | `contextManagementMode: "native"` | `contextManagementMode: "openviking"` |
   | VikingBot | OpenViking still manages context (`session_context_enabled: true`), and commits explicitly request Working Memory | `session_context_enabled: false` for the local mode |

   ```bash
   # Enable Working Memory for a single commit
   curl -X POST "$OV_URL/api/v1/sessions/$SID/commit" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"enable_working_memory": true}'
   ```

2. **Plugin commits archive every message (#5459):** commits from Claude Code, Codex, DSH, OpenCode and pi (outside takeover mode) now send `keep_recent_count: 0`, and `commitKeepRecentCount` / `OPENVIKING_COMMIT_KEEP_RECENT_COUNT` is no longer read. Previously every commit held the newest 10 messages back, so short sessions that ended within 10 messages were never archived or extracted. The server now counts `pending_tokens` over all live messages, so token-threshold commits fire slightly earlier than before.

3. **Context-mode recall results change (#5679, #5627):** `/api/v1/search/search` with `mode: "context"` no longer returns preset system directories (`viking://resources`, `viking://agent` and its children, the user root and its first-level directories). Category quotas are first-pass ceilings; unused slots go to the best remaining results from other categories, the total stays the same, and a quota of `0` still turns a category off. A directory URI in `exclude_uris` now excludes its whole subtree; it used to match the exact string, so a directory excluded nothing. Results for the same query may differ from v0.4.23.

4. **MCP `remember` result text changes (#5678):** it used to always return `Stored N message(s) and committed for memory extraction.`; it now says N messages were submitted for extraction and includes the `task_id`, or explains why nothing was committed. Extraction runs in the background and may produce no memories. Callers that parse the old text need to be updated. OpenClaw `memory_store` again returns `action: "failed"` with `error: "no_memories_extracted"` when nothing is extracted.

5. **CLI configuration management follows the selected file (#5551):** when `OPENVIKING_CLI_CONFIG_FILE` is set, `ov status`, `ov config validate`, the wizard and configuration management all use that file. Named profiles are discovered next to it, and `ov config switch` writes that file instead of the default one; the selected named file cannot be deleted or renamed. Unset the variable to manage the default store.

6. **DSH plugin (#5522, #5733):** DSH session IDs with Windows-invalid characters or trailing dots or spaces are normalized and get a hash suffix; such existing sessions map to a new OpenViking session after the upgrade, while already-portable IDs keep their mapping. The plugin's DSH peer range widens to `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <1.0.0-0`.

7. **Hermes Quick Local version range (#5710):** Quick Local setup installs `openviking[local-embed]>=0.4.22,<0.5`, so running setup again installs the latest 0.4.x release, not 0.5.0.

## First-time Contributors

- @varun-projects — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5627
- @yu1128-L — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5591
- @wongzw — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5694
- @krsish — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5686

Full Changelog: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.4.23...v0.5.0
